messages:
sahil: Hey @people-ops — need advice. Been getting repeated interruptions from a teammate in the open area and a lot of low-priority pings that break deep work. Manager mentioned a small performance dip in my last 1:1. I'm thinking a short-term accommodation: 2 days/week remote + a quieter desk for 3–4 weeks while we try workload realignment. Can this stay confidential? Thanks.

luke: @sahil thanks for flagging this. I want to support — we had a quick sync and I don't want a performance note to become punitive. I'm OK with trial remote days and reducing meeting load. I can reassign a couple tasks temporarily. Looping @tara from People Ops to start the process.

tara: thanks @luke @sahil. People Ops can run an interactive accommodation process. Practical options: 1) temporary hybrid schedule with written trial plan; 2) temporary seat reassignment to the quieter pod; 3) temporary workload realignment for named deliverables; 4) formal ADA accommodation if needed. You can start with our intake form: https://intranet.redwood/pplops/accom-intake (internal). Documentation is optional but helpful. We keep records private — People Ops + manager + HR lead. If you want full confidentiality from your manager, tell me and we'll discuss tradeoffs (some operational fixes may be limited). Want me to open a case? :white_check_mark:

sahil: Yes please open a case. I prefer that only the necessary facts reach my manager. I'm not comfortable sharing medical details in public channels.

tara: okay opening now. Quick Qs: which two days do you want remote? and which active deliverables should be reduced or reallocated?

sahil: Tues/Thurs remote would work. Can we shift the code review window by an hour? And pull me off sprint task "Search-UX X" for 3 weeks and reassign it.

marta: happy to pick up Search-UX X for a few sprints. @luke can we reassign? :+1:

luke: thanks Marta, yes we can swap. Also note: Sahil would like to keep Friday oncall coverage for now. We'll adjust meeting invites and expectations.

people-ops-bot: Case #2026-412 opened by tara. Private channel created: #pops-2026-412. Assigned HR lead: simon. (automated)

simon: hi @sahil — I'm the HR lead on this. I'll DM you to collect any optional docs and confirm the 3–4 week timeline. Proposal: 4-week trial with a 2-week check-in. We'll document the plan and outcomes; it will be marked as an accommodation and not disciplinary. Anything else you'd like included?

sahil: That plan sounds good. Appreciate the quick help and discretion. :heart:

tara: I'll draft the trial accommodation plan and post it in the private channel for signatures. I'll also add a private manager note clarifying this is supportive and shouldn't affect reviews publicly. Luke — please avoid adding anything to shared performance docs.

luke: Understood. I'll keep manager notes private and work with Marta on the handoff. Thanks everyone.

(End of thread)
